name: auth
title: Auth
description: Cookie-session authentication for Lunora — email/password sign-up/sign-in on top of @lunora/auth (a thin wrapper over better-auth), with the auth instance + request handler wired into your project and verification / forgot-password mail routed through @lunora/mail (captured into the studio Mail tab in dev).
docs: Mount handleAuthRequest in your Worker entry (see the README), set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (a 32+ char secret — `openssl rand -base64 32`) and BETTER_AUTH_URL. `lunora init` / `lunora add auth` prompt for the D1 database name (or pass `--db`); the low-level `lunora registry add auth` writes the `database_name` placeholder. Either way, create the database (`wrangler d1 create <name>`) and put its id in wrangler.jsonc's DB binding. In dev, ensureMigrated(auth) auto-applies the schema; in production prefer compileMigrationsSql(auth.options) piped to `wrangler d1 execute`. Verification + reset emails are captured into the studio's Mail tab in dev; for real delivery run `lunora add email` (adds the SEND_EMAIL binding) or set RESEND_API_KEY.

envVars.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
envVars.description: Encryption secret for better-auth sessions (min 32 chars). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

envVars.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of your app, used by better-auth for callbacks and cookies.

envVars.name: MAIL_FROM
envVars.description: Sender address for verification / password-reset emails. Captured into the studio Mail tab in dev; needs a verified domain for production delivery.
